learning_objective: 🎯 Step into the world of building! Understand the basics of civil construction, masonry, plumbing, and how to read a blueprint.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Before a single brick is laid, an architect draws a detailed map called a blueprint. It shows exactly where the walls, doors, windows, and pipes will go.
The foundation is the hidden base underground. It must be extremely strong and made of concrete because it carries the entire weight of the building above it.
Masons use bricks, blocks, or stones, binding them together with mortar (a sticky mixture of cement, sand, and water) to build strong, straight walls.
Once the walls are up, plumbers install pipes for clean water and drainage. Electricians lay down wires inside the walls to provide power for lights and fans.
Construction sites have heavy falling objects and sharp tools. Wearing hard hats (helmets), steel-toe boots, and safety harnesses at heights is strictly mandatory.

fun_activity.title: 🧱 Sugar Cube Masonry
fun_activity.instructions: Gather some sugar cubes and thick icing (or peanut butter). Try to build a small wall by placing the cubes like bricks and using the icing as 'cement' (mortar). Notice how you must overlap the joints to make it strong!

exam_tips: 📌 Explain why the foundation is the most important part of a building (it bears the load and prevents sinking).
📌 Know the roles of different workers: Architect (designs), Mason (builds walls), Plumber (water pipes), Electrician (wiring).
📌 Mortar is the paste that holds bricks together, made of cement, sand, and water.
quick_recap: ⭐ Construction is a team effort requiring many different skilled vocations working together.
⭐ A building is only as strong as its foundation and the quality of materials used.
⭐ Proper planning (blueprint) saves time, money, and prevents dangerous structural mistakes.
